notes.title: Producer Game Tittles
notes.notes:
Hello folks. My name is Rodrigo Banzato. I'm here to share with you my other 3 titles.


https://store.steampowered.com/app/2516430/Cyborg3003/

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1388350/Parallel/

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1121510/Shadows_of_Kepler/


Games are my passion and I love to learn and improve my works. I graduated in Design in 2003 and since then I am studying and improving my works.

I did Shadows of Kepler in 2019 with 3 friends and my most recent work is Parallel, I am developing by myself and started in January 2020.

Hope you have a great time playing your games. Thanks.

notes.title: Ola amigos, sou o Rodrigo, desenvolvedor de Clown2Beat, quero falar...
notes.notes:
Hi. This is Rodrigo, the developer of Clown2Beat. I started a new project called Parallel in January 2020 and I intend to release this new game in 2022. I have a very special affection for Clown2Beat because he opened the doors of game production for me, trained me and served as a ladder for another game as well. , the Shadows of Kepler. I'll leave here the most recent video I made of this new project.

[previewyoutube=CE0jHaxvzhE;full][/previewyoutube]

Anyone who can help, add the game to the Steam Wish List 🙏

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1388350/Parallel/

With the necessary resources, maybe I can go back with all my might to Shadows of Kepler, and maybe totally redesign Clown2Beat for a new version, lighter, more precise and with several new features. Developing games is my biggest passion and it's what I chose for my life.🚀

Thank you from my heart to everyone who supports me and gives me the strength to never give up.

[img]https://cdna.artstation.com/p/users/avatars/001/362/044/large/1af5827158c1652e17f1de42cac0af2e.jpg?1597382611[/img]
Rodrigo Banzato

notes.title: New RPG game Parallel
notes.notes:
[h1][b]Welcome to the Parallel World[/b][/h1]

If you like the game, add it to your [b][url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1388350/Parallel/]Steam Wishlist[/url][/b]

[i]Parallel is a first-person RPG adventure game, which makes the player decide on important choices. It brings various types of emotions that make people think about life. Each player will go through different environments, from mysticism, paradise to claustrophobic and destruction scenes.[/i]

[previewyoutube=751CCnx7YT0;full][/previewyoutube]

[i]If you like to explore, unravel mysteries, solve puzzles, learn about a new world, make your own choices, this game is made for you.
[/i]

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1388350/Parallel/][img]https://cdnb.artstation.com/p/assets/images/images/029/391/199/large/rodrigo-banzato-screenshots5.jpg?1597386158[/img][/url]

[i]The player may experience sadness, happiness, nervousness, etc. It all depends on what he wants to do in the game. With charismatic characters and specific scenes, this game brings a lot of immersion. Immersion is definitely the strongest part of this game, moving to mystical and very attractive moments.[/i] 

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1388350/Parallel/][img]https://cdna.artstation.com/p/assets/images/images/029/391/124/large/rodrigo-banzato-parallel-joker-imagem19.jpg?1597438001[/img][/url]

[i]I am working really hard on this game, with a lot passion and love. I hope I can bring the best game experience possible for you. Cordially, [url=https://www.artstation.com/rodrigobanzato]Rodrigo Banzato[/url][/i]

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1388350/Parallel/][img]https://cdnb.artstation.com/p/assets/images/images/029/391/261/large/rodrigo-banzato-parallel-rpg-imagem9-vertical.jpg?1597386361[/img][/url]
[i]
If you want to know more about this game, stay tuned to our newsletter and other social networks, check the official website[/i] [url=http://www.parallel-game.com]www.parallel-game.com[/url]

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1388350][img]https://cdna.artstation.com/p/assets/images/images/029/391/126/large/rodrigo-banzato-parallel-joker-imagem20.jpg?1597385785[/img][/url]
